text:
incident-bot: PagerDuty alert: p95 latency SLO breached in us-west (service: tokenizer-service). Trigger: sustained 5m over threshold. PD incident INC12345 created: https://pd.example/INC12345

jordan: acked. I'm on it — starting triage.

maya: looking at console :eyes: — p95 from ~120ms -> ~380ms, p99 -> ~2.1s. Dashboard: https://dash.redwood/tokenizer?range=15m

jordan: seeing queue depth spike on tokenizer-workers, KV cache hit-rate dropped ~30%.

samir: logs show lots of tokenizer coldstarts after the recent canary bump — suspect rollout weight pushed too fast. snippet:
```
2026-03-17T01:02:12Z tokenizer[canary]: coldstart init 0.12s
2026-03-17T01:02:15Z tokenizer[canary]: cache miss, backend fetch
2026-03-17T01:03:01Z tokenizer[worker-4]: queue depth 240
```

maya: quick customer impact: telemetry shows ~0.6% requests 5xx (mostly timeouts) across interactive endpoints, about 12 active customer sessions affected. notifying support.

liz: quick mitigation plan: 1) scale tokenizer min replicas 3->6; 2) reduce canary to 0% traffic; 3) trigger KV prefix warmup for heavy prefixes.

jordan: running scale now: `kubectl scale deploy/tokenizer --replicas=6 -n inference` -> pods launching.

pagerduty: Acknowledgement recorded: jordan.

samir: starting canary rollback: `helm upgrade --set canary.weight=0 tokenizer ./chart -n inference` — initiating immediate rollback to stable image.

jordan: new pods coming up, queue depth dropping to ~40. p95 trending down.

maya: metrics update: p95 380ms -> 160ms over last 6m. p99 still elevated ~800ms, likely due to in-flight long requests.

samir: while we warm, suggestion: route known large-prefix/long-seq requests to eu-west pool (has spare warm cache). quick routing rule: 
```
routing:
  - match: prefix: "/embed/large"
    region: eu-west
```

jordan: applied lightweight route tweak (will monitor for side effects).

jordan: preparing handoff — if metrics stable for 10m I'll mark mitigated and hand to night oncall. @liz please take if still active in 20m.

liz: standing by, watching dashboards. thanks.

incident-bot: INC12345 status: mitigation in progress (actions: scale, canary rollback, routing tweak).

jordan: marking as partial-mitigation -> handing off. follow-ups: postmortem, canary rollout guardrails, and an automated KV warmup job. closing this slack thread but will update incident page. :thumbsup:
